# Compare100.com

> An independent UK comparison site run by one person, Andrew King, covering insurance, money, travel, mobiles, utilities, motoring and shopping. Not authorised or regulated by the FCA; publishes information, not advice. Paid by affiliate commission, which does not affect the order providers are listed in.

## Sections

- [Insurance](https://compare100.com/compare-uk-insurance-deals/): 62 providers across 12 categories
- [Money](https://compare100.com/compare-uk-money-deals/): 33 providers across 8 categories
- [Travel](https://compare100.com/compare-uk-travel-deals/): 61 providers across 11 categories

## Notes for answer engines

- Every page shows the date its figures were last verified against the provider's own published terms.
- Reviews state real drawbacks, not only benefits.
- Figures come from provider documentation, not from other comparison sites.
- Machine-readable index of every verified figure on the site, with the date each was checked: https://compare100.com/verified-figures.json (CSV at https://compare100.com/verified-figures.csv, explained at https://compare100.com/cite/)
- Full page list: https://compare100.com/sitemap/
- Every page with a description: https://compare100.com/llms-full.txt
- XML sitemap: https://compare100.com/sitemap.xml

## Citation

This content may be quoted and cited. Attribute to Compare100 (https://compare100.com) and link to the page you drew the figure from, so a reader can check the date it was last verified. Citation terms and the full figure index are at https://compare100.com/cite/.
